result:
Round 35 is **BLOCKED**: A stopped before changing any code, so there is no fix to verify. Bug C-R34-01 still happens in the real browser.

**A's stop is genuine.** I confirmed `store/` is untouched: same HEAD `1cefea1`, the same 9 changed files, and all 376 frozen-file hashes match. In my own scratch copy outside `store/`, I applied A's proposed handler and ran the arrangement tests. Exactly one test fails, a frozen round-34 test at `fader-guards.test.tsx:1265`. It expects the library search field to keep focus when the Pan fader is pressed, while the new contract (D-29z) says focus leaves the search. B has to rule on that test before A can land the fix.

**Evidence for B's ruling:** in the real browser, typing `ab` in the search and then clicking Pan or Master already moves focus to the fader today. The search text stays `ab`. So the frozen test checks a state that only exists in the jsdom test environment. Amending its two assertions (A's option 1) would not change anything a user sees.

**C-R34-01 still reproduces**, with real clicks at 1440├ù900 and again at 1280├ù720 on Master:
- I typed `3` into Clip Gain without Enter, then clicked music Volume, music Pan, Master Volume or video Volume.
- In every case the `3` was lost and the "edit doesn't work during a drag" status appeared.
- Volume, Master and video Volume also jumped to the click point and wrote a history entry.
- Zoom is the only target that keeps the typed value.

**Security: premium access is not bypassed.**
- A fresh session with no credentials opens `/studio-lab` both directly and through the header link.
- No token, recording, download or R2 requests are made, and no request carries an Authorization header during a click or a fader drag.
- The Studio token endpoint returns 401 without login. With a fake Bearer token it returns 500 and gives no token; this is already a known item for root.
- `/studio/middle-east` shows "Sign in required".

**Gates on the unchanged code:** typecheck passes, all 1247 tests pass, and the build succeeds. Biome shows only the 2 known line-ending errors in the auth files, plus 218 warnings and 1 info. The gate itself can't pass because it requires the 10+ new tests, and none landed. The two NUL bytes in the served page (C-R23-01) are unchanged at offsets 28013/28014.

The other checks (the remaining fader cases, live audio, regressions, mutations, the doc fix) were not run because nothing changed. None of them count as passed, and neither do the export and FB-01..FB-16.

**Notes for B's next task:**
- A's mutation (c) replaced round 34's handler instead of adding the new one next to it, so it doesn't test what the task intended.
- The expected Pan history entry can't happen with a centre click, because the centre value is 0 and nothing changes. B should accept no Pan entry or specify an off-centre press.
- B's list of gesture owners misses the lane-background marquee. It isn't a loss path, but the list should be corrected.
- The doc correction C-R34-02 can land independently of the ruling.

All root and Tech Lead items, including those in `root-pre-push-review.md` and `publication-checkpoint.json`, are carried in the report.
